title.zh: 在莱特省Sogod市镇设立急诊医院，名称为Sogod急诊医院，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Sogod, Province of Leyte, to be Known as the Sogod Emergency Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of an Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Sogod, Province of Leyte, to be Known as the Sogod Emergency Hospital, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Cấp cứu tại Thị trấn Sogod, Tỉnh Leyte với tên gọi Bệnh viện Cấp cứu Sogod, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉินในเทศบาล Sogod จังหวัด Leyte ในชื่อโรงพยาบาลฉุกเฉิน Sogod และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat di Kotamadya Sogod, Provinsi Leyte dengan nama Rumah Sakit Gawat Darurat Sogod, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital Kecemasan di Perbandaran Sogod, Wilayah Leyte dengan nama Hospital Kecemasan Sogod, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There shall be established under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, an emergency hospital in the Municipality of Sogod, Province of Leyte, to be known as the Sogod Emergency Hospital.
The Secretary of Health shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said hospital during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-one. Thereafter, the necessary sum, for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
